test_copy_model_attributes: test the copy_model_attributes function that copies custom attributes between PyTorch model modules
collect_model_attributes: collect custom attributes from all named submodules of a PyTorch model into a nested dictionary
apply_model_attributes: apply a dictionary of custom attributes to matching submodules of a PyTorch model
copy_model_attributes: copy specified custom attributes from a source PyTorch model to a target model
test_TestUtilsModelUtils: run the TestUtilsModelUtils unit test class to verify model attribute copying works correctly
